title: ThinkPHP 5 Remote Code Execution
description: A ThinkPHP 5.0.20 application, vulnerable to the ThinkPHP 5 routing RCE (5.0.22 and 5.1.29 fixed it): without forced routing, the controller name in the URL can name any class with its namespace, and call its methods with request parameters.
question: Exploit the ThinkPHP 5 routing flaw to run a command on the server and read /ctf/flag.
